title.narrative: Integrated Social Protection Development Program (Additional Financing)

description.narrative: The ongoing program aims to strengthen and expand social protection system to alleviate poverty of poor women and their families through three outputs: (i) institutional capacity for social protection and climate resilience strengthened; (ii) access to primary and secondary education improved for children and adolescents of poor families; and (iii) access to health services and nutrition supplies enhanced for women, adolescent girls, and children of poor families. The additional financing of $330 million will expand the scope and coverage of the ISPDP, as part of the broader government program, mainly to enhance the ability of the Benazir Income Support Programme (BISP), Pakistan's flagship social protection agency, to deliver its programs and services to the 'grassroots level through further integrated system, support access to education pathways for children and youth from poor families, increased access to health services and nutrition supplies for beneficiaries in disaster-prone areas by enhancing poverty targeting.

Output: Access to health services and nutrition supplies enhanced for women, adolescent girls, and children of poor families. Indicator: Participating health facilities with ease of payment. At least 120 facilitation centers are established in qualified health facilities (tehsil headquarter hospitals, rural health centers, and/or basic health units) in the 87 target districts participating in the CCT-health and nutrition program. At least 90% of CCT health and nutrition static facilitation centers has deployed at least one ATM or POS (DLI 9.4) (2020 baseline: Zero in target districts and no ATM or POS) (OP 2.2.2, OP 2.4.1). Progress/Status: Ongoing. A total of 247 facilitation centers have been established in 87 districts. A need assessment exercise is going on to determine the need for provision of POS/ATM at the facilitation centers which will be completed within 2025 as per schedule. Prior results achieved for AF: In 65 other target districts, 171,361 PLWs and 271,319 children were paid two installments against the target of 150,000 pregnant and lactating women and 150,000 children aged two years and/or below paid against compliance with BISP CCT-HN conditionality. Primary and secondary graduation numbers. At least an additional 1,880,000 CCT-education stipend enrolled children with active status (at least 900,000 girls) graduate from primary school, and 644,685 (at least 273,559 girls) graduate from secondary school (up to grade 10, DLI 2.2). (2020 baseline: 55,275 CCT-education stipend beneficiary girls and 68,779 boys graduated at primary level; NA at secondary level) (OP 1.1.1; OP 2.2) Progress/Status: Program was approved in December 2024 and it remains on track as to its deliverables. Prior result target for AF for 2024 (Secondary Graduation): Another 91,520 girls and 136,091 boys graduated secondary during 2024 against targets of 22,000 girls and 28,000 boys for 2024, making cumulative total of 193,367 girls and 288,639 boys against 3 years target of 50,000 girls and 75,000 boys. Hence the AF prior result target for 2024 has also been achieved. Data Source: b. BISP MIS Actual value:
